title: Comparison maps for punctured flasque resolution cohomology
statement: For a commutative Noetherian ring R, an open W of Spec R, an injective resolution I of R, and n, there are additive homomorphisms between Modules.H of the unit module on W and the homology carrier of puncturedSectionsComplex R W I.cocomplex which are mutually inverse.

proof.text: Use the exact augmentation of the explicitly restricted associated abelian-sheaf complex.

Each term of I is injective. The associated sheaf is flasque; restriction and forgetting scalars preserve surjectivity of its restriction functions. Flasque abelian sheaves have zero positive cohomology. Identify this cohomology with right-derived terminal evaluation to obtain termwise acyclicity.

Apply the acyclic-resolution criterion to global abelian sections. Identify sheaf cohomology with derived terminal evaluation (degree zero by Sheaf.H.equiv₀, positive degrees by the derived-evaluation theorem).
Use the proved sections-complex isomorphism and the homology comparison for forgetting R-modules to abelian groups, then take the forward and inverse additive homomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_flasque_resolution_comparison_maps
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (I : InjectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat.{u} R)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
        (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) n →+
        ((puncturedSectionsComplex R W I.cocomplex).homology n).carrier,
      ∃ g : ((puncturedSectionsComplex R W I.cocomplex).homology n).carrier →+
        Modules.H (X := W.toScheme)
          (SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) n,
      (Function.LeftInverse g f) ∧ (Function.RightInverse g f)
